stances_toward.note: Our reading (confidence C). The since date is the AP report's date, not the start of the crackdown, which the source read does not date. The AP account presents the crackdown on the street gangs as the government's central project under a state of emergency. No government statement calling the gangs an existential enemy was read, and no formal terrorist designation was found, so the adversary grade is the weakest of this card and should be checked against the government's own words. Bond grievance: an open wound between state and gang, not kinship. Trend stable, since the crackdown continues in the August 2025 report.

relations_to.summary: Government crackdown on the street gangs under a state of emergency that suspended some constitutional rights, as the AP reported in August 2025. The start date of the emergency and any formal terrorist designation of the gangs are not in the source read.
